paragraphs: Halda sells an enrollment platform to colleges, universities and K-12 independent schools. It is pitched at enrollment teams asked to improve outcomes and lower cost per enrollment without extra budget or staff. AI agents individualize each interaction across a school's site, calls, texts and emails.

On the website, AI search and individualized content aim to earn an inquiry from students who would otherwise read a few pages and leave. An Engagement Score flags which anonymous visitors deserve staff attention. Behavioral emails and SMS react to what a student does, and an SMS and voice agent answers after hours. Yield surveys try to surface what is holding admitted students back before the deposit deadline. Conversion analytics tie each touchpoint to an enrolled student.

Halda connects to Slate, Salesforce and analytics tools with two-way sync, so it runs alongside a CRM rather than replacing it. The company says student data is fully FERPA and SOC 2 Type II compliant. It states that most institutions are fully live within 90 days. The platform is said to work in more than 40 languages. Halda says it was founded in 2021, starting from a question about enrollment.

quote.text: Our AI agents individualize every interaction across your site, calls, texts, and emails
